_doc: Editorial overlay for the inter-series link mesh. Two layers: (1) universes = tight shared-canon/franchise families that get a 'Same universe' edge; (2) watch_next = hand-picked 'if you finished X, BollyAI points you at Y' picks that outrank every computed edge. SLUGS MUST EXIST in data/series/. Notes are third-person, no first-person viewing claim, no fabricated numbers, <= ~14 words. Computed mesh (genre/region/platform/era) covers the long tail; this file covers the marquee. Consumed by site/scripts/build-series-links.mjs.
